# STEM Bridge Initiative

> Bridging the digital divide by building computer labs and providing STEM education in developing regions.

STEM Bridge Initiative is a student-led organization based in Washington State. Our mission is to tackle the root of inequality by providing poorer countries and regions with the tools for a proper STEM education.

## Current Projects
- Yervandashat, Armenia: Building an engineering lab in a border village school for up to 700 students.
- Lanjaghbyur, Armenia: Completed computer lab providing digital literacy to ~200 students.
